correctness.rationale: A direct interpolation derivation gives a three-dimensional companion recurrence. Its exact rational characteristic cubic yields four necessary-and-sufficient Schur-Jury tests; coefficient-positivity certificates prove three universally and one reduces to a degree-seven polynomial with one positive root. The neutral endpoint is simple. Nine independently computed singular expansion terms give the limiting quadratic and the exact s=2 threshold. The packaged checker reconstructed all critical identities from actual source code, not old logs.
